description.value:
Trigger You take physical damage

Effect You release the collected kinetic energy around you in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10], dealing @Damage[1d4[force]|options:area-damage] damage for every 10 damage you took (minimum 1d4) to all creatures in the area. Affected creatures must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class|basic] save against your class DC. On a critical failure, they're additionally knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Prone].
